subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should OpenClaw expose a persistent TUI submit/newline preference, or stop after documenting the pinned editor's existing bindings and fallbacks?
rationale: The observable multiline capability already ships, but preference persistence, config naming, CLI wiring, defaults, and compatibility would become a new OpenClaw product contract.

options.title: Document current behavior
options.body: Add public and in-product guidance for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and backslash-Enter without introducing a new setting.

options.title: Add persistent preference
options.body: Define a narrow TUI submit-shortcut configuration contract and wire it to the upstream keybinding manager with fresh-install and upgrade coverage.

recommendation.title: Document current behavior
recommendation.body: Add public and in-product guidance for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and backslash-Enter without introducing a new setting.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion and current TUI history make this person the strongest available owner for the configuration-versus-documentation decision.
